tools.name: cancel_prepared_order
tools.description: Cancel and delete the private content of an untouched unpaid prepared draft before payment starts. Returns the same minimal status shape as get_order_status, with status cancelled or expired. Paid, claimed, or checkout-open orders cannot be cancelled here.

orderRef.description: The orderRef of the prepared draft to cancel.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create PieterPost's hosted payment link for one prepared order. Returns {orderRef,preparedOrderId,amountCents,currency,paymentLinkUrl,expiresAt,status,paymentStatus,fulfillmentStatus,statusUrl,updatedAt}. It never creates a second mail order.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key scoped to this prepared draft and payment-link operation.

paymentMethod.description: Optional hosted checkout method; auto is recommended.

preparedOrderRef.description: The orderRef returned by prepare_letter or prepare_postcard.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Get minimal status only. Returns {orderRef,status,paymentStatus,fulfillmentStatus,statusUrl,updatedAt}. status is draft, payment_processing, checkout_open, paid, queued, fulfilled, failed, cancelled, or expired. No message, address, email, or private payment URL is returned.

orderRef.description: The PieterPost orderRef returned by a prepare operation.

tools.name: list_session_orders
tools.description: List minimal status for up to four PieterPost orders prepared or checked in this browser tab. Returns {ok:true,data:{orders:[status],unavailableOrderRefs:[string]}}. The list is session-only and contains no message, address, email, or payment URL.

tools.name: prepare_letter
tools.description: Validate, price, and prepare one letter without paying or sending it. Returns an expiring order with orderRef, amountCents, currency, recipient summary, status fields, nextActions, and payment endpoints; address-warning errors include details.addressWarnings.

acceptUsAddressWarnings.description: Set true only after reviewing details.addressWarnings from an earlier attempt.

attachmentAssetIds.description: Up to three asset IDs returned by upload_mail_asset.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key for safe retries of this exact draft.

message.description: Exact final letter text, with line breaks preserved.

recipient.description: One normalized postal recipient. Address lines exclude the recipient name; do not infer missing address details.

stampImageAssetId.description: Optional letter-stamp-image asset ID returned by upload_mail_asset.

tools.name: prepare_postcard
tools.description: Validate, price, and prepare one postcard without paying or sending it. Returns an expiring order with orderRef, amountCents, currency, recipient summary, status fields, nextActions, and payment endpoints; address-warning errors include details.addressWarnings.

acceptUsAddressWarnings.description: Set true only after reviewing details.addressWarnings from an earlier attempt.

frontImageAssetId.description: Optional postcard-image asset ID returned by upload_mail_asset.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key for safe retries of this exact draft.

message.description: Exact final postcard text, with line breaks preserved.

recipient.description: One normalized postal recipient. Address lines exclude the recipient name; do not infer missing address details.

tools.name: upload_mail_asset
tools.description: Upload one PDF, PNG, or JPEG for a letter attachment, letter stamp, or postcard front. Use the returned assetId in a prepare tool. Returns {ok:true,data:{assetId,contentType,kind,name,originalName,publicUrl,size}} or the standard error envelope.

fileBase64.description: Base64 file bytes. Use fileUrl when the file has an HTTPS URL.

fileUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL. Private, local, and redirected private URLs are rejected.
